svg.title: Ultra Game Stash
svg.script:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <base target="_top">
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://i.postimg.cc">

  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      font-family:
        "Comic Sans MS",
        "Comic Sans",
        cursive;
    }
    :root {
      --orange: #ff7900;
      --orange-light: #ffad42;
      --black: #0c0c0c;
      --panel: #181818;
      --panel-light: #242424;
      --white: #fff5e9;
      --muted: #c6b8a8;
    }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at top,
          #512300 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #080808,
          #1b0c02 55%,
          #090909);
    }
    button,
    input,
    textarea {
      font: inherit;
    }
    button {
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 18px 22px;
      background: rgba(8, 8, 8, .96);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--orange);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px #0009;
    }
    .brand {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 38px);
      font-weight: bold;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      text-shadow: 0 0 16px #ff790055;
    }
    .brand span {
      color: white;
    }
    nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .nav-button {
      border: 1px solid #59300e;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #1d1d1d;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      transition: .2s;
    }
    .nav-button:hover,
    .nav-button.active {
      color: #111;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          var(--orange-light),
          var(--orange));
      border-color: var(--orange-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    main {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: auto;
      padding: 28px 20px 60px;
    }
    .page {
      display: none;
      animation: appear .22s ease;
    }
    .page.active {
      display: block;
    }
    @keyframes appear {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(5px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
    .hero {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 55px 22px;
      border: 1px solid #66340c;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          140deg,
          #271103,
          #101010 65%);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 38px #0006;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      font-size: clamp(34px, 6vw, 58px);
      color: var(--orange-light);
      text-shadow: 0 0 22px #ff790044;
    }
    .hero p {
      max-width: 650px;
      margin: 0 auto 22px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 30px;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }
    .section-description {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 0 0 24px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }
    .card {
      padding: 20px;
      border: 1px solid #3c291a;
      border-radius: 17px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #222,
          #121212);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px #0004;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }
    .card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      font-size: 21px;
    }
    .card p {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .button {
      display: inline-block;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 11px 17px;
      color: #111;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #ffb64f,
          #ff7900);
      font-weight: bold;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: transform .2s, filter .2s;
    }
    .button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      filter: brightness(1.12);
    }
    .button.secondary {
      color: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid #5c3518;
      background: #262626;
    }
    .button-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }
    .announcement-date {
      color: #ffad42;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .gаmе-image {
      display: block;
      width: calc(100% + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      margin: -20px -20px 14px;
      border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
      background: #101010;
    }
    .field {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      margin: 6px 0 12px;
      border: 1px solid #49301c;
      border-radius: 10px;
      outline: none;
      color: white;
      background: #101010;
    }
    .field:focus {
      border-color: var(--orange);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ff790022;
    }
    textarea.field {
      resize: vertical;
      min-height: 90px;
    }
    label {
      display: block;
      color: var(--orange-light);
    }
    .status {
      color: var(--muted);
      min-height: 22px;
      margin: 10px 0;
    }
    .footer {
      text-align: center;
      color: #988a7c;
      padding: 28px 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid #39210f;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .settings-launcher {
      position: fixed;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 18px;
      z-index: 1000;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      border: 2px solid #ffad42;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #fff5e9;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #3b1b05,
          #111);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 22px #000a, 0 0 15px #ff790044;
      font-size: 25px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      transition: transform .2s, background .2s;
    }
    .settings-launcher:hover {
      transform: rotate(25deg) scale(1.06);
    }
    .settings-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1001;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #000b;
      backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
    }
    .settings-overlay.open {
      display: flex;
    }
    .settings-dialog {
      width: min(100%, 480px);
      max-height: min(85vh, 700px);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid #ff7900;
      border-radius: 20px;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #241105,
          #101010 70%);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 60px #000c, 0 0 28px #ff790022;
    }
    .settings-heading {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .settings-heading h2 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--orange-light);
    }
    .settings-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid #68401d;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #21170f;
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    .settings-intro {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .layout-option {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding: 15px;
      border: 1px solid #523116;
      border-radius: 13px;
      text-align: left;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #171411;
      transition:
        border-color .2s,
        background .2s,
        transform .2s;
    }
    .layout-option:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      border-color: #ffad42;
    }
    .layout-option.selected {
      border: 2px solid #ff9b2f;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          120deg,
          #422006,
          #1b1510);
    }
    .layout-option strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .layout-option span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .topbar {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 230px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 26px 14px;
      border-right: 2px solid var(--orange);
      border-bottom: 0;
      box-shadow: 5px 0 25px #0008;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .brand {
      font-size: 27px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin: 8px 0 28px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar nav {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .nav-button {
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 12px 14px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar main {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin-left: 230px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .footer {
      margin-left: 230px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero {
      text-align: left;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero p {
      margin-left: 0;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero .button-row {
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight {
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          circle at 88% 9%,
          #443064 0%,
          transparent 22%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 8% 40%,
          #211638 0%,
          transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(
          150deg,
          #090711,
          #120d20 58%,
          #08070d);
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .topbar {
      position: relative;
      background: rgba(9, 7, 17, .94);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #4d3a68;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px #0005;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .brand,
    body.layout-moonlight .hero h1,
    body.layout-moonlight .section-title,
    body.layout-moonlight .card h3,
    body.layout-moonlight label {
      color: #e0caff;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight nav {
      gap: 8px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button {
      border-color: #514064;
      border-radius: 9px 9px 3px 3px;
      background: #171020;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button:hover,
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button.active {
      color: #140d20;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #eadcff,
          #b58aff);
      border-color: #eadcff;
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px #b58aff2b;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight main {
      max-width: 1180px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(210px, .85fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px 34px;
      min-height: 300px;
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 58px);
      text-align: left;
      border: 1px solid #58416f;
      border-radius: 8px 38px 8px 38px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          115deg,
          #21152e 0%,
          #171020 56%,
          #100c18 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 44px #0005, inset 0 0 45px #a66cff0a;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero::after {
      content: "";
      grid-column: 2;
      grid-row: 1 / span 3;
      justify-self: center;
      width: clamp(130px, 17vw, 205px);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          circle at 34% 30%,
          #fff8ff 0%,
          #e6d5ff 26%,
          #b69bdd 54%,
          #70558d 72%,
          #352343 73%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 35px #c7a4ff55, 0 0 95px #8d5cc52a;
      opacity: .9;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero h1 {
      grid-column: 1;
      margin: 0;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero p {
      grid-column: 1;
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 590px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero .button-row {
      grid-column: 1;
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: 18px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .card {
      border: 1px solid #49365f;
      border-radius: 5px 20px 5px 20px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #21182d,
          #100d17);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px #0004;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .grid > .card:nth-child(4n+1) {
      grid-row: span 2;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .button {
      color: #170d22;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #eadcff,
          #b58aff);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 18px #a66cff22;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .button.secondary {
      color: #f7efff;
      border-color: #624080;
      background: #21182b;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .field {
      border-color: #624080;
      background: #100d17;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .footer {
      border-top-color: #49305c;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      body.layout-moonlight .hero {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero::after {
        display: block;
        width: 105px;
        margin: 24px auto 0;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero p {
        margin: 12px auto 20px;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero .button-row {
        justify-content: center !important;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .grid > .card:nth-child(4n+1) {
        grid-row: auto;
      }
    }
    body.layout-bottom {
      padding-bottom: 82px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at top,
          #512300 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #080808,
          #1b0c02 55%,
          #090909);
    }
    body.layout-bottom .topbar {
      position: relative;
      top: auto;
      padding: 22px 20px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #59300e;
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-bottom .brand {
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    body.layout-bottom nav {
      position: fixed;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: 12px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 900;
      width: max-content;
      max-width: calc(100% - 24px);
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 7px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid #8d4a13;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(12, 10, 8, .96);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #000b, 0 0 18px #ff790022;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    body.layout-bottom .nav-button {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 9px 13px;
      border-radius: 11px;
    }
    body.layout-bottom nav {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    body.layout-bottom main {
      padding-top: 28px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 22px;
      padding: 14px 24px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--orange);
    }
    body.layout-topbar .brand {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      margin: 0;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: clamp(21px, 2.4vw, 30px);
    }
    body.layout-topbar nav {
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .nav-button {
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    body.layout-topbar main {
      max-width: 1180px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(220px, .8fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px 36px;
      text-align: left;
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 58px);
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero h1 {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero p {
      margin: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero .button-row {
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
      margin-top: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    }
    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      body.layout-topbar .topbar {
        display: block;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .brand {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      body.layout-topbar nav {
        justify-content: center;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero p {
        margin: 0 auto 22px;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero .button-row {
        justify-content: center !important;
      }
    }
    body.layout-imac {
      --imac-accent: #a9d9ff;
      padding-bottom: 150px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 50% -10%,
          #263b61 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 90% 65%,
          #31234f 0%,
          transparent 38%),
        linear-gradient(
          160deg,
          #080d18,
          #111522 52%,
          #090b12);
    }
    body.layout-imac .topbar {
      position: relative;
      background: rgba(8, 12, 22, .76);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #6e91bb55;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px #0003;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
    body.layout-imac .brand,
    body.layout-imac .hero h1,
    body.layout-imac .section-title,
    body.layout-imac .card h3 {
      color: #d9ecff;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav {
      position: fixed !important;
      left: 50% !important;
      right: auto !important;
      top: auto !important;
      bottom: 14px !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%) !important;
      z-index: 1000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: clamp(7px, 1.2vw, 14px);
      width: max-content;
      max-width: calc(100% - 28px);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      overflow: visible;
      border: 1px solid #d7e9ff35;
      border-radius: 25px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          rgba(36, 48, 70, .82),
          rgba(12, 17, 29, .88));
      box-shadow: 0 15px 42px #0008, inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff20;
      backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(145%);
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex: 0 0 68px;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
      width: 68px;
      height: 68px;
      padding: 6px 3px;
      overflow: visible;
      border: 1px solid #ffffff22;
      border-radius: 19px;
      color: #eef6ff;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #3a4a66,
          #202b40 62%,
          #182235);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 12px #0005, inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff20;
      font-size: 0;
      line-height: 1;
      white-space: normal;
      transform-origin: center bottom;
      will-change: transform;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      transition:
        transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2, .75, .25, 1),
        box-shadow .38s ease,
        border-color .32s ease,
        filter .38s ease,
        background .32s ease;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button::before {
      display: block;
      font-size: 27px;
      line-height: 1;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #0005);
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button::after {
      content: attr(data-dock-label);
      display: block;
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: #eaf3ff;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
      line-height: 1.1;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      letter-spacing: .1px;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=home]::before {
      content: "🏠";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=announcements]::before {
      content: "📣";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=gаmеs]::before {
      content: "🎮";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=сhаt]::before {
      content: "💬";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=about]::before {
      content: "👻";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=suggestions]::before {
      content: "💡";
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav {
      transition: box-shadow .42s ease, background .42s ease;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav:has(.nav-button:hover) {
      box-shadow:
        0 19px 48px #0009,
        0 0 26px #87c9ff14,
        inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff2b;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button:hover {
      z-index: 4;
      transform: translateY(-13px) scale(1.16);
      border-color: #c6e4ffb8;
      box-shadow:
        0 14px 28px #0009,
        0 0 24px #87c9ff48,
        inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff4a;
      filter: brightness(1.16) saturate(1.08);
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button:hover::after {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 5px #0009;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav:has(.nav-button:hover) .nav-button:not(:hover) {

<body>
  <header class="topbar">

  <main>
    <section id="home" class="page active">

          and suggest what should be added next.

        <div class="button-row" style="justify-content:center">
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('gаmеs')">🎮 Browse Gаmеs</button>

            📰 Announcements
          </button>

      </div>

      <div class="grid">
        <div class="card">
          <h3>🎮 Gаmеs</h3>

          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('gаmеs')">View Gаmеs</button>

        <div class="card">
          <h3>💬 Сhаt</h3>

        <div class="card">

    </section>

    <section id="announcements" class="page">

        Updates, news, and announcements. Edit their URLs in the configuration below.
      </p>
      <div id="announcementsGrid" class="grid"></div>

    <section id="gаmеs" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">🎮 Gаmе Stash</h2>

        Choose a gаmе to open its fetched HTML in a new about:blank tab.
      </p>
      <div id="gаmеsGrid" class="grid"></div>
    </section>

    <section id="сhаt" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">💬 Сhаt Room</h2>
      <p class="section-description">
        Open the external сhаt to talk with other players.

      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="about" class="page">
      <h2 class="section-title">👻 About Ultra Gаmе Stash</h2>
      <div class="card">
        <h3>Your Halloween Gаmіng Hub</h3>
        <p>
          Ultra Gаmе Stash V2 is a functional website that provides District 303 students with the ability to play a variety of video gаmеs. Some of the gаmеs are AI, and some are real!
Us as students, have discovered that finding gаmеs can become extremely difficult considering our district blocks everything, so we fixed this issue!
Every single gаmе on our website is completely functional and provides a fun experience for students.  Bored in class, no work, or just bored? Then come check out our gаmе selection.
Alongside the gаmеs, we have a сhаtroom to engage with others from your district.
Thank you for using Ultra Gаmе Stash V2!
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="suggestions" class="page">

    const externalСhаtUrl = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/N3rdy3333/my-games@main/inndex.html";

    /*
      ============================================================
      FETCH HTML AND WRITE IT INTO ABOUT:BLANK
      ============================================================

      This follows your example:
        1. Open about:blank immediately from the click.
        2. Fetch the configured URL.
        3. Read the response as text.
        4. Write the HTML into the blank tab.

      Relative asset URLs are given the original page's base URL.
    */

    function openInAboutBlank(url) {
      let parsedUrl;
      let newWindow;

      try {
        parsedUrl = new URL(url);
        if (parsedUrl.protocol !== "https:" || parsedUrl.hostname !== "cdn.jsdelivr.net") {
          throw new Error("Only HTTPS URLs hosted on cdn.jsdelivr.net are allowed.");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        alert("Invalid URL: " + error.message);
        return;
      }

      // Open the blank tab immediately during the click, before any async work.
      newWindow = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");

      if (!newWindow) {
        alert("Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.");
        return;
      }

      function showLoading() {
        try {
          newWindow.document.open();
          newWindow.document.write(
            "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><title>Loading...</title>" +
            "<style>body{background:#111;color:#ffad42;font-family:sans-serif;" +
            "display:grid;place-items:center;height:90vh}</style></head>" +
            "<body>Loading gаmе...</body></html>"
          );
          newWindow.document.close();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Could not display loading page:", error);
        }
      }

      function showError(message) {
        if (!newWindow || newWindow.closed) return;
        const safeMessage = String(message || "Unknown error").replace(/[&<>"]/g, ch => ({
          "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """
        }[ch]));

        try {
          newWindow.document.open();
          newWindow.document.write(
            "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><title>Unable to load</title>" +
            "<style>body{background:#111;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;padding:30px}" +
            "h2{color:#ffad42}</style></head><body><h2>Could not load this page</h2><p>" +
            safeMessage + "</p><p>The URL must be reachable and return HTML.</p></body></html>"
          );
          newWindow.document.close();
        } catch (error) {
          alert("Could not load page: " + message);
        }
      }

      function writeFetchedHtml(html) {
        if (!newWindow || newWindow.closed) return;

        const baseHref = new URL(".", parsedUrl.href).href;
        const baseTag = '<base href="' +
          baseHref.replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/"/g, """) + '">';

        html = String(html).replace(/<base\b[^>]*>/gi, "");

        if (/<head\b[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
          html = html.replace(/<head\b[^>]*>/i, match => match + baseTag);
        } else if (/<html\b[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
          html = html.replace(/<html\b[^>]*>/i, match =>
            match + "<head>" + baseTag + "</head>"
          );
        } else {
          html = "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head>" + baseTag +
            "</head><body>" + html + "</body></html>";
        }

        newWindow.document.open();
        newWindow.document.write(html);
        newWindow.document.close();
      }

      showLoading();

      // Apps Script fetches the HTML server-side to avoid browser CORS failures.
      if (window.google && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(writeFetchedHtml)
          .withFailureHandler(error => showError(error && error.message ? error.message : error))
          .fetchRemoteHtml(parsedUrl.href);
      } else {
        // Fallback for copies opened outside Apps Script, if the host permits CORS.
        fetch(parsedUrl.href)
          .then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
            return response.text();
          })
          .then(writeFetchedHtml)
          .catch(error => showError(error.message || error));
      }
    }

    function openConfiguredСhаt() {
      if (!externalСhаtUrl) {
        alert("Add your external сhаt URL to the externalСhаtUrl setting in Index.html.");
        return;

      openInAboutBlank(externalСhаtUrl);
    }

    /*

      ============================================================
    */

    function makeCard(title, description, buttonText, url, extraText, imageUrl) {
      const card = document.createElement("article");
      card.className = "card";

      // Optional image. With no URL (or if it fails to load) the card looks exactly like before.
      if (imageUrl && String(imageUrl).trim()) {
        const image = document.createElement("img");
        image.className = "gаmе-image";
        image.alt = title;
        image.loading = "lazy";
        image.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
        image.addEventListener("error", () => image.remove());
        image.src = String(imageUrl).trim();
        card.appendChild(image);
      }

      const heading = document.createElement("h3");
      heading.textContent = title;
      card.appendChild(heading);

      if (extraText) {
        const extra = document.createElement("div");
        extra.className = "announcement-date";
        extra.textContent = extraText;
        card.appendChild(extra);
      }

      const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
      paragraph.textContent = description;
      card.appendChild(paragraph);

      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.className = "button";
      button.textContent = buttonText;

      // Both gаmе and announcement buttons use the fetch-to-about:blank method.
      button.addEventListener("click", () => openInAboutBlank(url));

      card.appendChild(button);
      return card;
    }

    function renderGаmеs() {
      const grid = document.getElementById("gаmеsGrid");
      grid.replaceChildren();

      gаmеs.forEach(gаmе => {
        grid.appendChild(
          makeCard(gаmе.title, gаmе.description, "Play Gаmе →", gаmе.url, "", gаmе.image)
        );
      });
    }

    function renderAnnouncements() {
      const grid = document.getElementById("announcementsGrid");
      grid.replaceChildren();

      announcements.forEach(announcement => {
        grid.appendChild(
          makeCard(
            announcement.title,
            announcement.description,
            "Open Announcement →",
            announcement.url,
            announcement.date || ""
          )
        );
      });
    }

        button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.page === pageId);

    const suggestionsUrl = "https://forms.gle/hf6Mupg9d2ZCakRn9";

    /*
      ============================================================
      WEBSITE LAYOUT SETTINGS
      The settings control sits outside the page sections, so it
      remains available when users switch pages.
    */
    const availableLayouts = ["classic", "sidebar", "moonlight", "bottom", "topbar", "imac", "liquid"];
    const mainNavigation = document.querySelector(".topbar > nav");
    const originalNavigationParent = mainNavigation ? mainNavigation.parentElement : null;

    // ============================================================
    // LIQUID GLASS DOCK ENGINE
    // A single glass lens lives inside the dock, behind the icons. It is described by four
    // spring-driven edges (left/right/top/bottom) so it can MOLD: when the pointer is near the
    // dock's outline the lens is a half-circle arch that is pulled out of that rim (its flat base
    // stays welded to the outline and its dome follows the pointer); as the pointer moves inward
    // the arch swells and rounds off into the full rounded square that cradles the icon. Leaving
    // does the reverse, sinking back into the rim. The lens never leaves the dock's bounds.
    // Everything is transform/opacity in one requestAnimationFrame loop that sleeps at rest.
    // ============================================================
    let liquidDockLens = null;
    let liquidDockReset = () => {};
    function setupLiquidDockLens() {
      if (!mainNavigation || liquidDockLens) return;
      const nav = mainNavigation;
      const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") : { matches: false };

      liquidDockLens = document.createElement("span");
      liquidDockLens.className = "liquid-dock-lens";
      liquidDockLens.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      nav.insertBefore(liquidDockLens, nav.firstChild);
      const lens = liquidDockLens;

      // ---- tiny spring toolkit ----
      const mk = (value, k, c, eps = .02) => ({ x: value, v: 0, t: value, k, c, eps });
      const snap = (s, v) => { s.x = s.t = v; s.v = 0; };
      const atRest = s => Math.abs(s.x - s.t) < s.eps && Math.abs(s.v) < s.eps * 5;
      const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
      const smooth = t => { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
      function step(s, dt, K, C) {
        const a = -s.k * K * (s.x - s.t) - s.c * C * s.v;
        s.v += a * dt;
        s.x += s.v * dt;
      }

      const L = {
        l: mk(0, 150, 23), r: mk(0, 150, 23),
        t: mk(0, 130, 21), b: mk(0, 130, 21),
        att: mk(1, 120, 20, .002),      // 1 = welded to the rim (arch), 0 = free rounded square
        pres: mk(0, 110, 19, .002),     // opacity
        press: mk(0, 400, 28, .002)     // mouse/finger-down squish
      };
      const MAG = .16, LIFT = 3, SIGMA = 64, PAD = 10, EDGE_PAD = 3;

      let btns = [];
      function measure() {
        btns = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(":scope > .nav-button")).map((el, i) => {
          const prev = btns[i];
          return {
            el, cx: el.offsetLeft + el.offsetWidth / 2, top: el.offsetTop, w: el.offsetWidth, h: el.offsetHeight,
            s: prev ? prev.s : mk(1, 430, 27, .0008),
            lift: prev ? prev.lift : mk(0, 430, 27, .02),
            press: prev ? prev.press : mk(0, 560, 30, .002),
            infl: 0
          };
        });
      }
      const halfPitch = i => {
        const d = [80];
        if (btns[i - 1]) d.push(btns[i].cx - btns[i - 1].cx);
        if (btns[i + 1]) d.push(btns[i + 1].cx - btns[i].cx);
        return Math.min(...d) / 2;
      };

      const ptr = { inside: false, x: 0, y: 0, down: -1, edge: "bottom" };
      const isLiquid = () => document.body.classList.contains("layout-liquid");
      function localPoint(e) {
        const r = nav.getBoundingClientRect();
        ptr.x = e.clientX - r.left - nav.clientLeft;
        ptr.y = e.clientY - r.top - nav.clientTop;
      }
      // Nearest outline edge, with a little hysteresis so the arch never flickers between edges.
      function pickEdge(navW, navH) {
        const d = { left: ptr.x, right: navW - ptr.x, top: ptr.y, bottom: navH - ptr.y };
        const m = Math.min(d.left, d.right, d.top, d.bottom);
        if (d[ptr.edge] > m + 6) ptr.edge = Object.keys(d).find(k => d[k] === m);
        return d[ptr.edge];
      }
      // The arch: a half circle whose flat base is welded to the rim at the pointer, tip reaching toward the pointer.
      function archRect(edge, depth, navW, navH) {
        const tip = Math.max(6, depth + 8);
        const half = tip;                                  // half-width == height, so it's a true half circle
        const M = 24;                                      // keep clear of the dock's rounded corners
        const px = clamp(ptr.x, half + M, navW - half - M);
        const py = clamp(ptr.y, half + M, navH - half - M);
        if (edge === "bottom") return { l: px - half, r: px + half, t: navH - 1 - tip, b: navH - 1 };
        if (edge === "top")    return { l: px - half, r: px + half, t: 1, b: 1 + tip };
        if (edge === "left")   return { l: 1, r: 1 + tip, t: py - half, b: py + half };
        return { l: navW - 1 - tip, r: navW - 1, t: py - half, b: py + half };
      }

      function retarget() {
        const motion = reduceMotion.matches ? 0 : 1;
        const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
        let near = -1, best = Infinity;
        if (ptr.inside) btns.forEach((b, i) => { const d = Math.abs(ptr.x - b.cx); if (d < best) { best = d; near = i; } });

        btns.forEach((b, i) => {
          const d = ptr.x - b.cx;
          b.infl = ptr.inside ? Math.exp(-(d * d) / (2 * SIGMA * SIGMA)) : 0;
          b.s.t = 1 + MAG * motion * b.infl;
          b.lift.t = LIFT * motion * b.infl;
          b.press.t = ptr.down === i ? 1 : 0;
        });

        let T;
        if (ptr.inside && near >= 0) {
          const depth = Math.max(0, pickEdge(navW, navH));
          const depthT = smooth(depth / Math.max(20, Math.min(40, navH * .36)));
          const A = archRect(ptr.edge, depth, navW, navH);

          // Full rounded square around the icon under the pointer, clamped to stay inside the dock.
          const b = btns[near];
          const d = ptr.x - b.cx;
          const s = b.s.x;
          const between = smooth(Math.abs(d) / halfPitch(near));
          const fw = Math.min((b.w * s + PAD + 6) * (1 - .2 * between), navW - 2 * EDGE_PAD);
          const fh = Math.min(b.h * s + PAD, navH - 2 * EDGE_PAD);
          const visCy = (b.top + b.h) - b.lift.x - (b.h * s) / 2;
          const fx = clamp(ptr.x + (b.cx - ptr.x) * .4 * (1 - between), fw / 2 + EDGE_PAD, navW - fw / 2 - EDGE_PAD);
          const fy = clamp(visCy, fh / 2 + EDGE_PAD, navH - fh / 2 - EDGE_PAD);
          const F = { l: fx - fw / 2, r: fx + fw / 2, t: fy - fh / 2, b: fy + fh / 2 };

          T = {};
          for (const k of ["l", "r", "t", "b"]) T[k] = A[k] + (F[k] - A[k]) * depthT;
          L.att.t = 1 - depthT;
          L.pres.t = 1;
        } else {
          // Leaving: the lens sinks back into the rim the pointer left through.
          pickEdge(navW, navH);
          T = archRect(ptr.edge, 0, navW, navH);
          const cx = (T.l + T.r) / 2, cy = (T.t + T.b) / 2;
          const rimX = ptr.edge === "left" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "right" ? navW - 1 : cx;
          const rimY = ptr.edge === "top" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "bottom" ? navH - 1 : cy;
          T = { l: Math.min(cx, rimX) - (ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right" ? 0 : 7), r: Math.max(cx, rimX) + (ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right" ? 0 : 7),
                t: Math.min(cy, rimY) - (ptr.edge === "top" || ptr.edge === "bottom" ? 0 : 7), b: Math.max(cy, rimY) + (ptr.edge === "top" || ptr.edge === "bottom" ? 0 : 7) };
          L.att.t = 1;
          L.pres.t = 0;
        }
        L.l.t = T.l; L.r.t = T.r; L.t.t = T.t; L.b.t = T.b;
        L.press.t = ptr.inside && ptr.down >= 0 ? 1 : 0;
      }

      function render() {
        btns.forEach(b => {
          const g = clamp((b.s.x - 1) / MAG, 0, 1);
          const sc = b.s.x * (1 - .07 * b.press.x);
          b.el.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${(-b.lift.x).toFixed(2)}px, 0) scale(${sc.toFixed(4)})`;
          b.el.style.setProperty("--i", g.toFixed(3));
          b.el.style.zIndex = String(2 + Math.round(g * 2));
        });

        const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
        const squish = 1 - .06 * L.press.x;
        const vx = reduceMotion.matches ? 0 : (L.l.v + L.r.v) / 2;
        const st = clamp(Math.abs(vx) / 1700, 0, .2);            // horizontal liquid stretch while moving
        let w = Math.max(1, (L.r.x - L.l.x) * squish * (1 + st));
        let h = Math.max(1, (L.b.x - L.t.x) * squish);
        let cx = (L.l.x + L.r.x) / 2, cy = (L.t.x + L.b.x) / 2;
        // Hard guarantee: the lens never pokes outside the dock.
        cx = clamp(cx, Math.min(w / 2, navW / 2), Math.max(navW - w / 2, navW / 2));
        cy = clamp(cy, Math.min(h / 2, navH / 2), Math.max(navH - h / 2, navH / 2));
        const sx = w / 100, sy = h / 100;

        // Corner radii (separate horizontal/vertical): while attached, the two tip corners are elliptical
        // quarter-arcs that join into a half circle; base corners (on the rim side) stay tight.
        // As att -> 0 everything blends back to the normal uniform rounded-square radius R.
        const R = Math.min(26, Math.min(w, h) / 2);
        const att = clamp(L.att.x, 0, 1);
        const rb = R - (R - 3) * att;
        const mix = target => R + (target - R) * att;
        const sideEdge = ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right";
        const tipX = Math.max(.5, mix(sideEdge ? w - rb : w / 2));
        const tipY = Math.max(.5, mix(sideEdge ? h / 2 : h - rb));
        let tl = [tipX, tipY], tr = [tipX, tipY], br = [tipX, tipY], bl = [tipX, tipY];
        const base = [rb, rb];
        if (ptr.edge === "bottom") { br = base; bl = base; }
        else if (ptr.edge === "top") { tl = base; tr = base; }
        else if (ptr.edge === "left") { tl = base; bl = base; }
        else { tr = base; br = base; }
        const fx = a => (a / sx).toFixed(2) + "px";
        const fy = a => (a / sy).toFixed(2) + "px";
        lens.style.transform = `translate3d(${(cx - 50).toFixed(2)}px, ${(cy - 50).toFixed(2)}px, 0) scale(${sx.toFixed(4)}, ${sy.toFixed(4)})`;
        lens.style.borderRadius =
          `${fx(tl[0])} ${fx(tr[0])} ${fx(br[0])} ${fx(bl[0])} / ${fy(tl[1])} ${fy(tr[1])} ${fy(br[1])} ${fy(bl[1])}`;
        lens.style.opacity = clamp(L.pres.x * 1.8, 0, 1).toFixed(3);
      }

      function allRest() {
        return Object.values(L).every(atRest) && btns.every(b => atRest(b.s) && atRest(b.lift) && atRest(b.press));
      }
      function cleanup() {
        lens.style.opacity = "0";
        lens.style.transform = "translate3d(0,0,0) scale(.01)";
        btns.forEach(b => {
          b.el.style.transform = ""; b.el.style.zIndex = "";
          b.el.style.removeProperty("--i");
          snap(b.s, 1); snap(b.lift, 0); snap(b.press, 0);
        });
      }

      let raf = 0, last = 0;
      function frame(now) {
        raf = 0;
        if (!isLiquid()) { cleanup(); return; }
        let dt = (now - last) / 1000; last = now;
        if (!(dt > 0)) dt = 1 / 60;
        dt = Math.min(dt, 1 / 30);
        const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dt * 240)), h = dt / n;
        const K = reduceMotion.matches ? 4 : 1, C = reduceMotion.matches ? 2 : 1;
        retarget();
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          for (const k in L) step(L[k], h, K, C);
          for (const b of btns) { step(b.s, h, K, C); step(b.lift, h, K, C); step(b.press, h, K, C); }
        }
        render();
        if (!allRest()) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        else if (!ptr.inside) cleanup();
      }
      function start() {
        if (raf) return;
        last = performance.now();
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function enter(e) {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        const wasInside = ptr.inside;
        measure();
        localPoint(e);
        ptr.inside = true;
        // A fresh entrance starts as a zero-size bead sitting exactly where the pointer crossed
        // the outline; re-entering mid-exit simply reverses from wherever the lens currently is.
        if (!wasInside && L.pres.x < .04) {
          const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
          ptr.edge = "bottom"; pickEdge(navW, navH);
          const x = clamp(ptr.x, 0, navW), y = clamp(ptr.y, 0, navH);
          const rimX = ptr.edge === "left" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "right" ? navW - 1 : x;
          const rimY = ptr.edge === "top" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "bottom" ? navH - 1 : y;
          snap(L.l, rimX); snap(L.r, rimX); snap(L.t, rimY); snap(L.b, rimY);
          snap(L.att, 1); snap(L.pres, 0);
        }
        start();
      }
      nav.addEventListener("pointerenter", enter);
      nav.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        if (!ptr.inside) { enter(e); return; }
        localPoint(e);
        start();
      });
      nav.addEventListener("pointerleave", e => {
        if (!isLiquid() || !ptr.inside) return;
        localPoint(e);
        ptr.inside = false; ptr.down = -1;
        start();
      });
      nav.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        if (!ptr.inside) enter(e); else localPoint(e);
        const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".nav-button");
        ptr.down = btn ? btns.findIndex(b => b.el === btn) : -1;
        start();
      });
      const release = () => { if (ptr.down !== -1) { ptr.down = -1; start(); } };
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", release);
      window.addEventListener("pointercancel", release);
      window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (isLiquid()) { measure(); start(); } });

      liquidDockReset = () => {
        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
        ptr.inside = false; ptr.down = -1;
        Object.values(L).forEach(s => snap(s, 0));
        snap(L.att, 1);
        cleanup();
      };
    }
    setupLiquidDockLens();
    const originalNavigationNextSibling = mainNavigation ? mainNavigation.nextSibling : null;

    function placeNavigationForLayout(layout) {
      if (!mainNavigation || !originalNavigationParent) return;
      if (layout === "imac" || layout === "liquid") {
        // Make the dock a direct child of <body>, so fixed bottom positioning is viewport-based.
        if (mainNavigation.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(mainNavigation);
      } else if (mainNavigation.parentElement !== originalNavigationParent) {
        if (originalNavigationNextSibling && originalNavigationNextSibling.parentElement === originalNavigationParent) {
          originalNavigationParent.insertBefore(mainNavigation, originalNavigationNextSibling);
        } else {
          originalNavigationParent.appendChild(mainNavigation);
        }
      }
    }

    function applyLayout(layout, saveChoice = true) {
      const safeLayout = availableLayouts.includes(layout) ? layout : "classic";
      placeNavigationForLayout(safeLayout);
      document.body.classList.remove("layout-sidebar", "layout-moonlight", "layout-arcade", "layout-pumpkin", "layout-bottom", "layout-topbar", "layout-imac", "layout-liquid");
      if (safeLayout === "sidebar") document.body.classList.add("layout-sidebar");
      if (safeLayout === "moonlight") document.body.classList.add("layout-moonlight");
      if (safeLayout === "bottom") document.body.classList.add("layout-bottom");
      if (safeLayout === "topbar") document.body.classList.add("layout-topbar");
      if (safeLayout === "imac") document.body.classList.add("layout-imac");
      if (safeLayout === "liquid") document.body.classList.add("layout-liquid");

      // Stop the Liquid Glass spring engine and clear its inline styles when leaving the theme.
      if (safeLayout !== "liquid") liquidDockReset();

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-layout-choice]").forEach(option => {
        const selected = option.dataset.layoutChoice === safeLayout;
        option.classList.toggle("selected", selected);
        option.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
      });

      if (saveChoice) {
        try { localStorage.setItem("ugsWebsiteLayout", safeLayout); }
        catch (error) { /* Settings still work for this page view if storage is blocked. */ }
      }
    }

    function setLayout(layout) {
      applyLayout(layout);
    }

    function openSettings() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      overlay.classList.add("open");
      document.getElementById("settingsLauncher").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    }

    function closeSettings() {
      document.getElementById("settingsOverlay").classList.remove("open");
      document.getElementById("settingsLauncher").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    }

    function closeSettingsFromBackdrop(event) {
      if (event.target === document.getElementById("settingsOverlay")) closeSettings();
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") closeSettings();
    });

    let savedLayout = "classic";
    try { savedLayout = localStorage.getItem("ugsWebsiteLayout") || "classic"; }
    catch (error) { /* Use the default layout when storage is unavailable. */ }
    applyLayout(savedLayout, false);


    renderGаmеs();
    renderAnnouncements();
    
  
  </script>
</body>
</html>
